title: RISE-RL: Rubric-Informed Selective Exploration for Open-Ended Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.09123v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) for open-ended tasks is challenging because responses must satisfy multidimensional criteria without following a single correct generation trajectory. Existing rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) methods compress fine-grained criterion-level feedback into scalar rewards, making persistent capability gaps difficult to target under limited on-policy exploration. We propose $\textbf{RISE-RL}$ (Rubric-Informed Selective Exploration), which uses repeatedly missed rubric criteria to elicit privileged trajectories that are difficult to discover through unguided exploration alone. RISE-RL retains only trajectories whose complete-rubric reward exceeds the mean reward of natural rollouts, and then re-evaluates them under the original prompt to emphasize behaviors that remain weakly supported by the natural policy. translated_title: RISE-RL：基于评分标准的开放式强化学习选择性探索
translated_abstract: 对大型语言模型（LLM）进行开放式任务对齐极具挑战性，因为模型的响应必须满足多维度的评价标准，而无需遵循单一的正确的生成轨迹。现有的基于评分标准的强化学习（RL）方法将细粒度的标准级反馈压缩为标量奖励，导致在有限的在策略探索下难以针对持续存在的能力差距进行优化。我们提出了RISE-RL（基于评分标准的选择性探索），该方法利用反复未满足的评分标准来引出难以通过无引导探索发现的特权轨迹。RISE-RL仅保留其完整评分标准奖励超过自然rollout平均奖励的轨迹，然后在原始提示下对这些轨迹进行重新评估，以强调自然策略仍然支持不足的行为。由此产生的引导信号通过单独的辅助目标进行优化并重新（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出RISE-RL方法，通过反复未满足的评分标准引出特权轨迹并经辅助目标优化引导信号，从而在开放式强化学习中更有效地针对模型持续存在的能力差距进行对齐。
en_tdlr: RISE-RL leverages repeatedly missed rubric criteria to elicit privileged trajectories and optimizes a guidance signal via a separate auxiliary objective, enabling more effective targeting of persistent capability gaps in open-ended reinforcement learning.
